description: Skip to the next Spotify track.
name: next

description: Return to the previous Spotify track.
name: previous

description: Play something from this listener's own music by description, matched semantically against their playlists, saved tracks, top tracks and recent plays. Only for requests with NO specific title: a mood, a vibe, an occasion, a language, or "something I like". If the request names a song or an artist, however loosely, use search_and_play instead.
name: play_from_taste

query.description: What the listener wants, in their own words: a mood, an artist, a language, an occasion. Not a Spotify search string.

description: Search all of Spotify and start playing the best match right now, replacing whatever is playing. Use this whenever a song title or an artist is named, even partially, even if it sounds like a phrase rather than a title — most requests naming words from a song belong here, not in play_from_taste. Also for corrections such as wanting a different version of the current track.
name: search_and_play

query.description: Spotify search query including useful track and artist details.

description: Search Spotify and add the best match to the end of the queue, without interrupting the current track. Only for requests that explicitly ask to queue something or play it later or next.
name: queue_search

query.description: Spotify search query including useful track and artist details.

description: Set Spotify playback volume to an exact percentage.
name: set_volume

description: Report the current Spotify track, artist, and playback state.
name: now_playing
